column1: # The P1 anchor scale (C5 §3.2 step 1b), read by tools/content_econ.py when it
# writes out/content/econ/prices.tsv. The server never reads this file; edit it
# and tools/up.sh re-extracts (the bundle's manifest records it as an `input`).
# A tier-1 PI product (a schematic whose inputs are not PI products) prices at
#   scale x the client's own per-tier import-tax multiplier
# read from the bundle (planets/pi-statics.tsv `taxmult` rows) at extract time;
# no client number is written here. Without it the P1 goods price at their
# basePrice and a PI chain is worth almost nothing. Tiers above compound through
# pi-markup.tsv as before. A price-overrides.tsv row still wins. Raw P0 stays
# unpriced. The price ripples into every recipe that uses a PI good.
# Exactly one row, finite, within content_econ.MIN_PI_ANCHOR .. MAX_PI_ANCHOR.
# [A] 1.0. Falsifier: a soak where PI chains still earn nothing, or where PI
# outearns every other career by far, or hulls/implants that use PI goods price
# out of reach of the bots that build them.

column2: [A] the client's own tax multiplier as the reference price; falsifier: PI earns nothing, or outearns every other career, or PI-using products price out of reach
